{{Quote|Well, regardless, the Sith don't let anybody near that valley. Even when we land, they watch us like a Drayberian hawk and want us gone quickly.|A pilot, on the Valley of the Dark Lords|<ref name="KOTOR" />}}
The '''Drayberian hawk''' was a type of [[Hawk (animal)/Legends|hawk]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> that hailed from<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Drayberia system/Legends|Drayberia system]], a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Sertar sector/Legends|Sertar sector]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It had a close, observant gaze.<ref name="KOTOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic}}
In [[3956 BBY]],<ref name="3956 BBY">''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' to [[3956 BBY]].</ref> [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] visited the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]]<ref name="KOTOR" /> of the Outer Rim's [[Esstran sector/Legends|Esstran sector]].<ref name="FaDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> There, in [[The Drunk Side]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] of the [[Dreshdae]] [[City/Legends|settlement]],<ref name="KOTOR" /> he<ref name="Revan">''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''</ref> met a pair of [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who were transporting [[Sith artifact/Legends|artifacts]] excavated by members of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]] at the ancient Sith [[Burial/Legends|tombs]] of the [[Valley of the Dark Lords/Legends|Valley of the Dark Lords]] offworld. [[Unidentified pilot (Korriban)|One]] of the pilots relayed to Revan that the Sith restricted access to that valley and even viewed the pilots with suspicion, comparing the Sith's observation of them to being watched by a Drayberian hawk.<ref name="KOTOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Drayberian hawk was introduced in the [[2003]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''. In the game, the creature can be mentioned in an optional conversation the player character, Revan, can have with a pair of pilots on the planet Korriban. This article assumes one hundred percent game completion and that the conversation took place as described.<ref name="KOTOR" />
